subject: Boot rooms and practical entrance storage
hook: Boot rooms and hallway storage, built to fit your entrance.
gbp:
Bespoke boot rooms and entrance storage.

A busy entrance needs somewhere for coats, boots, bags, dog leads and keys. Standard furniture rarely fits narrow hallways, porches or the space under the stairs, so we design and make entrance storage to the exact size of the space.

Who it's for: families, dog owners, walkers and anyone whose hallway has turned into a pile of shoes and coats.

What we make:
- Hallway benches with drawers, lift-up storage or open boot cubbies
- Coat zones with hooks and shelves at the right heights
- Tall cupboards for vacuums, pushchairs and sports kit
- Boot-room and utility storage, including under-stairs units

Finishes include matt, wood-effect and painted looks, plus slatted panels that let damp coats and boots air. Everything is made in our own workshop in Hanley, assembled before delivery and fitted by our own team.

We make entrance storage for homes in Leek, the Staffordshire Moorlands and across the Stoke-on-Trent area. Start with a free, no-obligation design consultation and an itemised quote. Tap Learn more to see our hallway storage.
